sentences.en: The fecundity and number of eggs hatched by C. chinensis were significantly reduced with increasing interspecific male density than with conspecific male density.

sentences.en: Insect host marking pheromones are chemical compounds produced by females and deposited on or into hosts to signal the presence of conspecific brood.

sentences.en: The biogeographic relationships between Amanita of East Asia and North America are much more clearly reflected by vicarious species than by conspecific taxa.
